industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Soluti
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited develops and maintains renewable energy projects, including solar and wind, for commercial and industrial customers through Renewable Energy Power Sales and Renewable Energy Services segments. Its assets include wind and solar farms, rooftop and ground-mounted solar and solar carports. It provides turnkey engineering, procurement and construction, plus operation and maintenance, and clients can buy green power via long-term agreements.
